beats.narration: That clunk when you shift into reverse isn't nothing.
beats.visualPrompt: Rear three-quarter shot of a pickup truck or SUV backing out of a driveway, static-mounted camera, shallow depth of field, dusk lighting for a slightly ominous tone.

beats.narration: A knock right as the driveshaft takes up slack — worse backing out of the driveway.
beats.visualPrompt: Low-angle underbody shot of a driveshaft mid-vehicle, subtle shudder/knock implied by a slight camera-shake cutaway; cut to a gear-shifter close-up moving from D to R.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two ~2.5s sub-shots before real generation to satisfy the 1.5-2.5s visual-change cadence.

beats.narration: One clue: a worn universal joint, where the driveshaft connects to the axle.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro/cutaway shot: a universal joint assembly removed from a driveshaft yoke, resting on a workbench, visible wear/play at the cross-bearing caps, slow push-in.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two sub-shots (wide + macro push-in) before real generation.

beats.narration: Left alone, that play can turn into a vibration — or worse, down the road.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on a driveshaft's center support bearing area with subtle visual vibration cue (soft blur pulse), dim shop-bay lighting, static mount.

beats.narration: Don't guess. A quick check underneath can find the play before it gets worse.
beats.visualPrompt: Underbody inspection shot: a pry bar or inspection light positioned near a U-joint (tool visible, mounted/clipped — no hand in frame), shop bay softly blurred behind.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two sub-shots before real generation.

beats.narration: Worth checking before a small clunk becomes a bigger repair. Stop by and we'll take a look. Nick's Tire & Auto.
beats.visualPrompt: Branded end-card plate: Nick's Tire & Auto shop bay wide shot, warm daylight, static hold.
beats.postCompositing: Real logo and CTA text overlay added in post via ffmpeg, never AI-generated.
